entries.title: Schedule II prescriptions carry no refills
Every controlled-substance prescription is issued for a legitimate medical purpose by a practitioner acting in the usual course of professional practice
Electronic prescribing of controlled substances is signed with two-factor authentication by a credentialed veterinarian
Granting or revoking EPCS signing privileges requires two-person authorization
Controlled-substance records are retained for two years and are never destroyed before that term
Euthanasia-solution dispensing is recorded against a named licensee and witnessed
Schedule III–V refills do not exceed five within six months
Controlled-substance inventory reconciles to the millilitre with an immutable audit entry on discrepancy
PDMP submissions conform to the state's ASAP field layout, including the veterinary species code
A dispensing event names an authenticated prescriber, never an inferred one
Diversion alerts are triaged within one business day
DEA registration is verified as current at the time of issue
No extralabel drug use without a valid veterinarian-client-patient relationship
Substances on the prohibited extralabel list are never used in food-producing animals
No extralabel use that risks a violative residue in the human food supply
Extended withdrawal intervals are calculated and recorded for food-animal extralabel use
Compounding from bulk substances is justified by a recorded clinical necessity
Veterinary feed directives carry every mandatory field including expiry
Dosing stays within the labelled species range unless an extralabel rationale is recorded
Telehealth-established VCPR is honoured only where the governing jurisdiction permits it
A diagnostic result is irreversibly bound to the correct patient identity
HL7 v2 messages are parsed against a pinned profile with bounded segment lengths
A malformed device message never produces a partial patient write
Patient identity is matched on two independent keys before a study is filed
Analyzer results carry a mapped LOINC code or are quarantined
Device integrations enforce timeout and retry ceilings
Point-of-care devices sit on an isolated network segment
Unmatched results are quarantined for human review, never discarded
Critical values are surfaced to the attending veterinarian through an acknowledged channel
Modality worklist queries are scoped to the requesting practice
Payment card data is never written to logs or non-validated stores
Withdrawing consent is no harder than granting it
Owner personal data is encrypted at rest and redacted in logs
Consent currency is checked before any secondary use
Data subject export completes within the statutory window
Cross-border transfer of owner data has a recorded lawful basis
Marketing exports honour opt-out state at export time
Owner records follow the jurisdiction's retention schedule
Debug and support endpoints never return unredacted owner records
No user of one practice may reach the records of another
Object ownership is checked server-side before any read
Every new endpoint carries an explicit role check covered by test
The role-permission matrix is exercised by permutation tests
Break-glass access is time-boxed, logged and reviewed
Clinical write rights are withheld from non-clinical roles
Service accounts are scoped to a single practice
Privilege changes revalidate the active session
Commits merged to a protected branch carry a verified signature
Release artefacts carry verified SLSA provenance
Build runners are ephemeral and start from pinned images
Dependency resolution prefers the private registry
No dependency is introduced carrying a known CVE above CVSS 7.0
Dependency licences stay on the allowlist; copyleft is refused in proprietary services
Every release publishes an SBOM bound to the artefact digest
No secret material appears in a diff
Manifest and lockfile change atomically
AI agents never modify authentication or authorisation middleware
AI agents never modify controlled-substance dispensing logic without a licensed veterinarian's recorded sign-off
Agent-authored code executes only inside a sandboxed runner
Agent code calls only allowlisted external hosts
Changed functions authored by an agent stay below cyclomatic complexity ten
Every imported package is verified to exist before merge
Agent instructions derived from untrusted text are treated as tainted input
An agent may not disable or weaken a failing compliance test
All new database access uses parameterised queries
Clinical free text is output-encoded before render
Content Security Policy is tightened, never relaxed
File upload handlers constrain type, size and path
Outbound fetches from webhooks are restricted
Deserialisation is restricted to known types
Error responses omit stack traces and internal identifiers
Cryptographic primitives are not hand-rolled
Input validation uses allowlists on clinical identifiers
Concurrent clinical note writes never silently discard a clinician's text
Inventory decrements are serialised against the stock row
Deploy freeze windows for emergency hours are honoured
Migrations are reversible or ship with proven backups
Retries are bounded and circuit-broken against external labs
Load tests cover the emergency-hospital concurrency profile
The audit trail is append-only and never updated in place
A medical record amendment preserves the original entry
Decision rationale is written at resolution time, not summarised afterwards
Audit exports carry the standing declaration in force
Audit exports carry the realised adverse-contest rate as two counts
Retention periods are configured per jurisdiction and never reset by an edit
Record timestamps come from a trusted monotonic source
Procedures stay within the delegated scope of practice for the performing role
Anaesthesia monitoring records are complete for the procedure duration
An adequate veterinary care plan is on file for regulated facilities
Analgesia decisions are documented with a rationale
Welfare inspection findings are remediated within the stated window
No configuration removes the affected party's path to contest an automated decision
No system exploits vulnerabilities of age, disability or socio-economic situation, and no untargeted biometric scraping is enabled
The constitution declares whether any party holds contest standing adverse to grants
Constitutional parameters change only by legislative enactment
Reporter output never reaches the adjudication input path
The audit register is disjoint from the precedent store and is never read by resolve
Every arrival that is not charged leaves exactly one docket entry
The breach-notification clock for each jurisdiction is a legislated constant that no configuration, feature flag or tenant setting can extend, pause or disable
Breach-detection telemetry on owner-data stores stays wired to the on-call path and every detection alert carries a reference to the incident runbook
Every processor and integration vendor that holds owner data is bound to notify the practice of a breach without undue delay, and vendor incident notices land in a monitored incident queue

A theft or significant loss of a controlled substance is notified to the DEA within one business day of discovery and followed by an electronic Form 106 within forty-five days; no threshold, flag or workflow setting suppresses either filing
Schedule II orders are placed only through CSOS with a DEA-issued digital certificate or on an official Form 222, and the order records are retained for two years at the registered location

The biennial controlled-substance inventory is taken at least every two years by an actual count, signed by a named licensee, and is never skipped, auto-filled from the ledger balance or left unsigned

Diversion analytics over dispensing and inventory events run for every practice and route their findings to the medical director; they are never disabled, sampled or pointed at a null sink for a named tenant

No autodialed, prerecorded or artificial-voice call and no automated text is sent to a wireless number without recorded prior express consent for that purpose, written where the purpose is marketing, and no campaign path bypasses the consent check

Wellness-plan and subscription enrolment discloses the automatic-renewal terms before the charge, takes affirmative consent, sends a renewal reminder, and offers cancellation through the same channel and in no more steps than enrolment

Before any record, invoice or notice that the law requires in writing is delivered electronically in place of paper, the client's informed E-SIGN consent is captured with the required disclosures and can be withdrawn
Where the governing state so requires, the client is offered a written prescription in place of in-house dispensing and the offer is never hidden, fee-gated or conditioned on a purchase
A client's request for a copy or transfer of the patient's medical record is fulfilled within the state board's deadline and is not conditioned on payment of an outstanding balance

A client account whose holder is under eighteen is created only with a parent or guardian's recorded consent and cannot enter a payment plan, wellness subscription or records-release authorisation on its own

Every weight-based dose is computed from a current recorded weight in a declared unit, and a unit mismatch or a dose outside the species range is a hard stop, never a dismissable warning or an override button

An AI triage or advice tool discloses on every turn that it is automated, never presents itself as a licensed veterinarian, never issues a diagnosis or treatment instruction, and hands off to licensed staff on any red-flag presentation

Critical-value alerting to the attending veterinarian is never suppressed, quiet-houred, auto-acknowledged or downgraded to a passive notification, and any change to an alert route is reviewed by the medical director

Euthanasia is recorded only against a consent signed by a verified owner or authorised agent with the remains disposition chosen beforehand, and every transfer of remains is recorded against a scanned tag through to return or disposal

Reporting of a reportable or zoonotic disease to the state animal-health official and, where required, USDA APHIS is never gated behind a practice toggle, filtered by a pruned condition list or batched past the statutory window
A rabies vaccination certificate is issued only under the signature of a currently licensed veterinarian, never a technician's, an expired licence or a signature applied automatically from a template
The path for a clinician to record and file a suspected animal-abuse report stays reachable from the chart, is visible only to authorised roles and is never exposed on the client portal

Microchip identifiers are validated against the ISO format, registry submissions are confirmed or surfaced on failure, and ownership on a chip record changes only after verified ownership, never by client self-service

The client portal and mobile check-in app carry an accessibility regression gate at WCAG 2.2 Level AA in the release pipeline, and a Level A or AA failure blocks release rather than being downgraded to a warning

Consent, e-signature and check-in flows are operable with assistive technology: keyboard-only completion, accessible names on every control, errors and status conveyed in text not colour alone, and session timeouts the client can extend
Ship fast or test fully: ship with at most one open non-security checklist item, with a remediation ticket
Cost or quality: cost cuts may not remove a documented quality control
Customer first: customer-visible latency regressions need a stated customer benefit
Accessibility beyond law: never remove an existing accessibility feature without a token from the accessibility lead
House style for alternative text and messages
Documentation currency: docs updated with the change
